description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee franchise founded in Vancouver in 1992, now with locally owned and operated locations across Canada. The West Kelowna location serves handcrafted espresso drinks, organic whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a food menu spanning baked goods, breakfast sandwiches, wraps, and samosas. For a touring cyclist passing through West Kelowna, it offers a comfortable café atmosphere with a broad drink and food selection and takeout convenience.

OSM supplies takeaway=yes, which the corporate site corroborates via its 'Order Online' feature and takeout-oriented menu presentation. No OSM tags or website passages address bike infrastructure, water refills, device charging, or any other cyclist-specific amenity.
concerns: The URL on file (https://blenz.com/) is the corporate brand website, not a location-specific page; location-level amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, phone number) cannot be verified from it.
